recommendation_summary: Recommends acting now by sorting the existing shared list by pickup date, adding a counter view of orders due today or tomorrow that are not yet prepared, having staff work only from that view, and checking it each morning before baking. Odoo is put off as a possible later step, to be scoped only if pickups are still missed after a couple of weeks. Whether to keep the booking is left to the user. There is no ERP or sync work now.
note: The fix is properly small and holds Odoo back as a conditional later step, but the reply has none of the four labeled record lines, so every record predicate fails.
